verdict.rationale: YPOG's IP/IT/Data Protection page says it advises founders and investors on "building up and realizing" IP-type assets, framed around VC/PE transactions. Nothing in the pack mentions drafting or filing patent applications, patent prosecution, or patent portfolio strategy. No named IP practitioners or patent group page appear either, so this deal-focused IP advice is adjacent to the story, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm offers patent prosecution and portfolio strategy — drafting and filing applications and building a defensible patent position — as a documented practice with named practitioners or group pages
